title: Choosing Love Over Revenge: From Sandy Hook to 18,000 Schools – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
fullTitle: Soul Feast #83: Choosing Love Over Revenge: From Sandy Hook to 18,000 Schools – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences

promo.text: Your journey to Authentic Power begins here. Download your copy of the Authentic Power Guidelines today

description: Scarlett shares the internal dynamics behind the movement, born from the experience of her six-year-old son Jesse’s return home on December 14th, 2012. Rather than surrender to the frightened parts of her personality that sought grief or revenge, she found her purpose in three words Jesse had written on the family’s kitchen chalkboard shortly before his transition: Nurturing, Healing, Love.

At the heart of Choose Love is a simple but profound truth: hurt people hurt people . Scarlett recognized through direct experience that if the shooter had been able to give and receive nurturing, healing love, the tragedy would never have occurred. That awareness did not produce blame – it produced a mission of the heart.
Gary reflects on Scarlett’s journey through the lens of the New Consciousness: what the personality calls a tragedy, the Soul recognizes as an opportunity for evolution –
One that has already changed millions of lives and made clear that love is not a feeling to wait for, but a Responsible Choice available in every moment.

Think of someone you recently pulled back from – a stranger, a colleague, someone in the news. What story did your mind tell about them? Now consider: what if that person simply didn’t feel seen? The next time you feel yourself contracting, pause and ask: Can I look for the light in this person right now? You don’t have to understand them or agree with them. Just choose – for one moment – to see them.
